  • A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

  • Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

  • RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

  • 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

  • Annual enrichment benefits:

    Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

    Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

  • 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

  • Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

How and Where We Work:

  • Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

  • For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

  • For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

  • Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

Key Responsibilities

As a Senior Software Engineer focused on agentic security, you'll build intelligent systems that empower security teams. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Build autonomous security agents that perform alert triage, secure code reviews, threat modeling, and vulnerability assessment

  • Develop agent orchestration systems that help security practitioners automate repetitive security tasks

  • Design and implement agent security controls to ensure our AI agents can safely interact with sensitive enterprise data

  • Create the security infrastructure that allows agents to operate in high-trust environments with stringent deployment requirements

  • Ship production-ready agent capabilities that run efficiently in resource-constrained environments

  • Research and implement novel security patterns for AI agent systems, sometimes requiring custom solutions where standard libraries fall short

  • Conduct security testing of both the agents you build and the platform that runs them.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience with a track record of shipping user-facing security features

  • Strong Python development skills with significant production experience

  • Experience building or working with autonomous systems, AI agents, or intelligent automation

  • Solid understanding of security principles including session management, authentication, authorization, and secure coding practices

  • Ability to think about security at multiple layers: application security, agent behavior security, and infrastructure security

  • Comfortable working across the full stack and diving into unfamiliar codebases to understand and fix issues

  • Thrive in fast-paced environments where you can adapt to evolving priorities

  • Excited about the intersection of AI/ML and security engineering.

Working Location

This role can be based remotely or from one of our office locations listed on the job description - there is no minimum in-office qualification requirement. We care most about hiring exceptional people regardless of locations, though please check the location listed on the posting for guidance around the core time zone or working hours alignment expected for the role.

  • RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

  • 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Why this role

Enterprises hand Cohere their most sensitive data and put our models inside workflows they can't afford to get wrong. Securing that means working on problems the industry hasn't settled yet, what authorization means when an agent acts on a user's behalf, how to contain tools that consume untrusted input, and whether tenant boundaries hold when a model can be steered by the data it reads. The established playbooks only take you so far.

We're hiring a Senior Product Security Engineer to work these problems alongside the engineers building the products, reviewing architecture and code, threat modeling before implementation, testing what ships, and turning what you learn into defaults other teams inherit. This is a hands-on engineering role, not an advisory one.

What you’ll do

  • Lead security reviews. Review architecture, code, and security-sensitive changes. Identify both individual vulnerabilities and the recurring design patterns behind them.

  • Secure AI-powered products. Evaluate risks such as prompt injection, unsafe tool use, identity and delegation failures, excessive agency, data exposure, tenant isolation, and sandbox escapes.

  • Threat model new capabilities. Identify trust boundaries, abuse cases, and high-impact failure modes before implementation. Translate findings into practical, prioritized mitigations.

  • Perform hands-on testing. Investigate suspected vulnerabilities, develop proofs of concept, assess exploitability and impact, and partner with engineers through remediation.

  • Build scalable guardrails. Develop secure defaults, approved patterns, reusable controls, review requirements, and automated checks that reduce recurring risks.

  • Strengthen engineering capability. Pair with engineers, document practical guidance, and help product teams develop durable security expertise.

  • Influence risk decisions. Explain technical findings, business impact, and remediation options clearly to engineers, product leaders, and executives.

You may be a good fit if

  • You have strong software engineering fundamentals and can independently understand, test, and contribute fixes to production codebases.

  • You are proficient in at least one of Python, Go, or TypeScript.

  • You have led security reviews or threat models for complex production systems and can point to meaningful design or risk improvements that resulted.

  • You understand common vulnerability classes and their underlying design failures, including injection, authorization flaws, IDOR, SSRF, unsafe deserialization, race conditions, cryptographic misuse, and software supply-chain risks.

  • You understand modern application architecture, including web applications, APIs, OAuth/OIDC, cloud platforms, containers, Kubernetes, and CI/CD systems.

  • You can reason rigorously about untrusted input, authorization, isolation, identity, delegation, and data boundaries. Direct experience with agentic AI systems is valuable but not required.

  • You have driven security improvements involving multiple engineering teams, including situations where influence mattered more than authority.

  • You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences.

Nice to have

  • Experience building or operating security tooling such as SAST, DAST, SCA, custom linters, or policy-as-code.

  • Experience securing multi-tenant SaaS, enterprise software, or systems that process sensitive customer data.

  • Offensive security experience through penetration testing, red teaming or security research.

  • Experience operating or participating in a vulnerability disclosure or bug bounty program.

  • Contributions to open-source security projects, published research, conference talks, or credited vulnerability discoveries.

Full-Time Employees at Cohere enjoy these Perks:

  • A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

  • Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

  • RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

  • 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

  • Annual enrichment benefits:

    Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

    Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

  • 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

  • Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

How and Where We Work:

  • Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

  • For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

  • For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

  • Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.


We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form, and we will work together to meet your needs.

We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.

Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers page.

  • Experience supporting multi-region sales organizations with cultural/time zone awareness

  • Proven ability to design and ship programs from scratch

  • AI-fluent with track record of scaling enablement using AI tools

  • Field-oriented approach—you thrive on direct deal reviews and coaching

  • Mastery of enterprise sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDPICC, Command of the Message) and CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce).

  • Clear communication across all levels (reps to leadership)

  • Comfort with ambiguity and building in fast-paced environments

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

Nice to Have

  • Technical fluency in AI/ML concepts (RAG, model selection, competitive differentiation)

  • Enterprise software sales experience

  • Sales enablement/instructional design certification

  • Hyper-growth enablement scaling experience

  • Additional regional languages

Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

About the Role
Are you passionate about secure-by-design software engineering? Do you want to be at the forefront of AI innovation and enterprise security? Cohere's North team is seeking a Software Engineer with a focus on security to join our mission and make a significant impact. This isn't a review-and-advise role, you'll own and ship production security features that customers rely on every day.


Your Role:
As a Senior Software Engineer with a security focus, you'll play a pivotal role in building and securing North's architecture. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Software Development: Contributing to the core development of security features such as OIDC/OAuth flows and session management, ensuring North's AI agents are secure

  • Secure Coding: Writing secure code to handle OIDC tokens, user claims, and sensitive data, adhering to best practices for JWT validation and encryption

  • Authentication and Data Protection: Implementing authentication mechanisms including user login, token management, and authorization checks to maintain data integrity

  • Tool Integration: Pulling in new tools to enhance North's security capabilities

  • DevSecOps: Design and implement secret management within Kubernetes clusters, including encryption and RBAC

  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Demonstrate strong soft skills to communicate security best practices to stakeholders in a clear and concise manner


You may be a good fit if:

  • Have 5+ years building user-facing security features in production systems

  • Ship production Python confidently and frequently

  • Understand OIDC/OAuth 2.0, JWT validation, and token lifecycle management deeply—not just conceptually

  • Have hands-on experience with Kubernetes in both development and production environments

  • Have worked across GCP, AWS, Azure, or hybrid/multi-cloud deployments

  • Are comfortable working across the stack

  • Communicate security concepts clearly to non-security engineers and stakeholders

  • Thrive in fast-moving environments where priorities evolve

  • Experience working with AI/ML systems or LLM-based applications

Full-Time Employees at Cohere enjoy these Perks:

  • A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

  • Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

  • RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

  • 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

  • Annual enrichment benefits:

    Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

    Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

  • 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

  • Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

How and Where We Work:

  • Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

  • For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

  • For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

  • Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.


We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form, and we will work together to meet your needs.

We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.

Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers page.

About the Role

We are seeking a proactive, customer-focused IT Support Specialist based in South Korea to anchor our regional IT operations across the APAC time zone. In this role, you will be the primary point of contact for internal employees, delivering white-glove technical support while managing core identity, collaboration platforms, and SaaS systems.

Beyond day-to-day helpdesk operations, this position bridges traditional IT support and modern systems engineering. You will leverage automation, scripting, and modern DevOps practices to streamline user lifecycles, eliminate manual toil, and ensure our workforce operates securely and efficiently.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the first point of contact for internal employees, triaging incoming requests through the ticketing system and established support processes.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve workstation, laptop, mobile, and basic network issues for on-site staff and remote employees, escalating more complex support cases to senior staff or the appropriate team.

  • Deliver calm, clear support during high-priority incidents, keep users informed, and document work thoroughly through to resolution.

  • Manage end-to-end employee onboarding and offboarding workflows, ensuring zero-day access provisioning, hardware readiness, and secure offboarding compliance.

  • Build and maintain support procedures and employee-facing knowledge base articles so common issues are handled consistently.

  • Partner with business units as a go-to support contact and communicate clearly, in writing and in person, across the organization.

  • Support new-hire onboarding and offboarding, including device setup, access requests, and day-one readiness.

  • Track hardware inventory and coordinate on device replacements and repairs.

  • Assist with password resets, MFA, email, and common productivity-tool issues so employees can get back to work quickly.

  • Provide hands-on support for printers, peripherals, and meeting-room technology when on-site help is needed

  • Stay eager to learn, take on special projects, and grow into broader IT support responsibilities.


Qualifications

  • Professional proficiency in English, and Japanese or Korean.

  • 5+ years of experience in help desk, internal IT support, or a similar technical support role. Experience in a fast-paced or global team is a plus.

  • Strong experience with supporting user accounts, password resets, MFA, and SSO, specifically with Okta and Google Workspace.

  • Experience with Mobile Device Management (MDM) platforms such as Iru (macOS) and Microsoft Intune (Windows).

  • Basic understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, Wi-Fi, and VPN), with familiarity supporting UniFi/Ubiquiti equipment a plus.

  • Comfort supporting employees in Slack and other everyday collaboration tools such as Microsoft Office 365 (channels, apps, notifications, and common access issues).

  • Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical colleagues across international teams.

  • A patient, helpful, solutions-oriented approach to supporting internal staff, with a commitment to follow-through and a positive experience for every request.

  • Annual enrichment benefits:

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

Why this role?

Cohere has a strong AI narrative, the most deployable product, and a CEO who co-authored the foundational paper of modern AI. The company is positioned to become the transatlantic leader in sovereign AI for enterprise and government, and needs a storytelling engine to deliver that story at scale. This role sits within the team that is building that engine.

We're looking for an Executive Producer, Executive Communications to own and evolve Cohere’s narrative globally as we grow to become the transatlantic leader in sovereign AI. This is a rare opportunity to use video as the primary medium to share voices and tell stories of executives at one of the fastest growing companies in the most dynamic space in technology.

In this cross functional role, you will partner directly with C-Suite and VP executives, helping to determine how we talk to customers, partners, and employees. The role takes Cohere's narrative—the through-line that connects sovereign AI, transatlantic growth, and the product story—and turns it into the content the world sees and shares.

You will execute Cohere's strategic narrative through various forms of content including video, podcast, and in-house production. While the role flexes across formats, we see video as the primary and most effective medium. The Executive Producer has dual aims: to grow the personal thought leadership profiles of Cohere's senior voices on their own channels and to deliver Cohere's narrative to the market through company channels.

As Executive Producer, Executive Communications you will:

  • Build and execute Cohere's strategic narrative across three storytelling surfaces: Executive Thought Leadership, Policy Storytelling, and Corporate Storytelling

  • Partner with the VP Global Communications on narrative architecture and translating Cohere's narrative into content strategy and execution across the aforementioned three storytelling surfaces

  • Audit and gap analyses across Cohere's senior voices including the co-founding team, CFO, Chief AI Officer, SVP Government Affairs, and various VPs supporting the business

  • Develop content playbooks for predictable inflection moments (regulatory milestones, product launches, customer wins, IPO milestones) to be launched on executive and company pages

  • Partner with Marketing to create content for company accounts

  • Stand up the production function including stage capture systems, content atomization workflows, and freelance crew networks

  • Build AI-enabled workflows using Cohere's own products (Command, North, Embed, Rerank) for transcript-to-asset pipelines, executive prep automation, and narrative consistency

  • Initiate executive stage content capture and distribution at major events with lean, scalable production

  • Conduct executive content audits and gap analyses across senior voices

  • Refine and systematize content production workflows with predictable cadences

  • Develop flagship thought leadership pieces and corporate storytelling output

  • Scale successful surfaces based on impact analysis and team capacity

You may be a good fit if you:

  • Have 8-10 years of experience building executive and corporate narratives from ideation through execution, ideally within a fast-paced, high-growth tech or AI environment

  • Are adept are creating production workflows from scratch (stage capture systems, content atomization pipelines)

  • Have experience in the high-paced broadcast television environment

  • Have experience building trust and rapport with executives and senior leaders naturally

  • Are scrappy. You thrive in thinking “outside the box” and find joy in marrying a problem to its solution

  • Are highly organized and process-driven, with strong project management skills and a bias for action

  • Bring high levels of creativity to communications – in format, channel, and storytelling

  • Are comfortable navigating organizational dynamics and building strong relationships across all levels

  • Thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and know how to ruthlessly prioritize

Ideal Candidate Profile The successful candidate will have experience in strategic communications, content production, and executive storytelling, with the ability to build scalable systems and leverage AI tools. They should be comfortable navigating executive relationships, managing production workflows, and adapting content strategies based on performance data. Experience in tech/AI environments and familiarity with Cohere's product suite would be valuable assets.

Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Role Summary

We seek a highly organized, automation-minded Delivery Operations Analyst to connect GTM and Delivery Engineering teams under a unified operational system. Core duties include owning operational processes, data quality, and automation that move customer opportunities from GTM brief through commercial approval to delivery assignment. Maintain accurate data across Salesforce and Mission Control to support delivery execution.

A core expectation is to identify, design, implement, and continuously improve automation across the GTM-to-Delivery workflow(affectionately called Deal Desk, using workflow automation, North, and other appropriate tools. You will own automation outcomes end-to-end, from identifying manual inefficiencies through implementation, testing, monitoring, and iteration.

The ideal candidate combines operational rigor with a systems mindset, proactively looking for ways to eliminate repetitive work, improve data quality, reduce coordination overhead, and build scalable processes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee the operational process for new customer briefs submitted by GTM to Deal Desk; ensure required information and proper routing for approval.

  • Coordinate the transition from commercial approval to the Engineering Program Manager for delivery team assignment.

  • Track opportunities through pre-delivery stages, identifying actions, blockers, and missing information.

  • Ensure clear, timely handoffs between GTM, Deal Desk, and EPM.

  • Maintain accurate, timely data from the Deal Desk process; keep Salesforce and Mission Control updated with customer, opportunity, commercial, and delivery details.

  • Establish standards for data entry, documentation, and operational hygiene.

  • Develop and maintain reporting on Deal Desk volume, pipeline progression, approvals, delivery assignments, and operational metrics.

  • Identify process trends, bottlenecks, and gaps; recommend efficiency improvements.

  • Develop and maintain process documentation, workflows, and operational playbooks.

  • Help establish clear ownership, SLAs, and operating standards across the workflow.

  • Identify opportunities to streamline, standardize, and automate manual processes across the GTM-to-Delivery workflow.

Qualifications

  • 2–4 years of experience in business analysis, operations, revenue operations, sales operations, project coordination, or similar roles.

  • Experience working with CRM and business operations systems.

  • Strong analytical and organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.

  • Comfortable working across multiple teams and managing processes with numerous stakeholders.

  • Strong skills in building automations and working with multiple AI tools

  • Ability to identify inconsistencies, investigate root causes, and drive issues to resolution.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Process oriented but being able to convert nebulous ideas into discreet actionable steps and systematizing work

  • Experience with data reporting, dashboards, or business intelligence tools is an asset.

Working Location:

This role can be based remotely from the Greater Toronto area, Montreal or Ottawa - there is no minimum in-office qualification requirement. We care most about hiring exceptional people regardless of locations, though please check the location listed on the posting for guidance around the core time zone or working hours alignment expected for the role.

Full-Time Employees at Cohere enjoy these Perks:

  • A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

  • Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

  • RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

  • 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

  • Annual enrichment benefits:

    Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

    Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

  • 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

  • Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

How and Where We Work:

  • Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

  • For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

  • For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

  • Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.


We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form, and we will work together to meet your needs.

We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.

Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers page.

Why this role?

The Admin team at Cohere is looking for an Executive Assistant to support Cohere's VP of EMEA, and to manage the Revenue global EA team.

In this dynamic and collaborative role, you will thrive in a fast-paced environment, working cross-functionally to provide high-value support. You will manage executive calendars, coordinate travel arrangements, enhance team cohesion through various initiatives, and take on diverse projects. Additionally, you will be responsible for managing a high performing team of EAs across the company.

We are seeking someone who is eager to dive into the challenges and opportunities that come with supporting our executive team. If you have a passion for providing seamless administrative support and contributing to a high-performing organization, this role is ideal for you.

In this role, you will:

  • Manage the day-to-day schedule for our VP of EMEA, including calendaring, booking meetings [internal and external] and other commitments to ensure a balanced and efficient workday

  • Coordinate internal and external meetings (think 1:1s, board meetings, partner meetings) and assist with documentation that may be required in conjunction with meetings

  • Oversee travel arrangements and logistics for our leadership team, including booking flights and accommodations, schedule, and expense reconciliation

  • Serve as a strategic partner to your executive, orchestrating cross-functional initiatives to drive executive productivity and effectiveness

  • Work directly with your executive’s department leads to drive strategic planning, manage priorities, and maximize your executive’s productivity

  • Manage the day to day operations for the Revenue EA team, including 1:1s, performance management, and career development

  • Work to identify new ways to add value and proactively take on tasks that can help our leadership team be more productive. We’re looking for someone who loves to optimize operations and processes and is equally excited to share their ideas with our team!

  • Take on special projects like coordinating team events or community-building activities

  • Communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders while maintaining a strict level of confidentiality

You may be a good fit if you have:

  • 5+ years of experience working as an Executive Assistant or equivalent experience

  • 2+ years of experience managing a high performing Admin team

  • You anticipate others needs and can work proactively to address them

  • Previous experience partnering with senior leaders in a fast-paced, innovative environment

  • You are a strong communicator, both written and verbal - and feel comfortable speaking to C-level stakeholders.

  • You are highly self-motivated and exercise discretion, tact, and professionalism

  • You’re detail-oriented, love staying organized, and stay cool under tight deadlines

  • Experience with tools like Slack, Google Calendar, Google Sheets, Google Slides

  • You enjoy a balance of collaborative and independent work.

  • Experience creating and maintaining positive working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

Full-Time Employees at Cohere enjoy these Perks:

  • A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

  • Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

  • RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

  • 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

  • Annual enrichment benefits:

    Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

    Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

  • 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

  • Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

  • Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Role Overview

As our VP of Sales - Global Public Sector, you will spearhead year-over-year global revenue growth by developing and executing on enterprise level PUBSEC customer acquisition strategies. You will drive long-term success through strategic development, coaching, and expanding Cohere’s presence in the public sector. In this pivotal leadership role, you will cultivate and guide our sales team to exceed revenue targets and organizational goals, while fostering a culture of excellence and innovation.

Key Responsibilities

As our VP of Public Sector Sales you will:

  • Develop, execute, and lead a comprehensive, global go-to-market growth strategy and sales plan for the Public Sector, driving revenue growth and market expansion working with other regional sales teams.

  • Provide sales and operational leadership to Cohere’s PUBSEC sales team, ensuring alignment with company objectives and priorities.

  • Partner with Marketing, Product, and Engineering teams to synchronize sales efforts with broader company goals.

  • Represent Cohere at PUBSEC industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities, as well as with regulators and government agencies, in collaboration with other regional and global leaders in Cohere.

  • Manage and nurture relationships with government decision-makers and partners to ensure Cohere’s success in the region. Identify and pursue new business opportunities, negotiating and closing high-value deals.

  • Collaborate with global teams to strengthen anchor relationships and establish best practices for enterprise-level project implementations, ensuring strong client engagement throughout project lifecycles.

Qualifications

This career opportunity may be a good match for you if you:

  • Have 10+ years of PUBSEC sales and leadership experience leading go-to-market efforts and driving revenue growth for fast paced technology organizations.

  • Have an established network, including federal agencies, prime contractors, and industry associations with an emphasis on the Defense and Intelligence communities.

  • Possess a proven track record of leading capture and sales efforts for consultative solution sales and business development efforts, with a deep understanding of regional procurement and budget cycles, customer success, and resource allocation.

  • Have exceptional communication and leadership skills, with the ability to build cross-functional relationships and influence at all levels.

  • Are comfortable operating in a matrix environment, coordinating efforts across cross-functional teams and regions without the need for a large direct organization.

  • Are a self-starter with an entrepreneurial mindset, capable of working independently, rolling up sleeves, and driving impact as a ‘builder.’

  • Experience in AI or a related industry is highly desirable.

  • Must be willing to travel (25-40%).

Working Location:

This role can be based remotely or from one of our office locations listed on the job description - there is no minimum in-office qualification requirement. We care most about hiring exceptional people regardless of locations, though please check the location listed on the posting for guidance around the core time zone or working hours alignment expected for the role.

Full-Time Employees at Cohere enjoy these Perks:

  • A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

  • Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

  • RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

  • 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

  • Annual enrichment benefits:

    Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

    Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

  • 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

  • Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

How and Where We Work:

  • Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

  • For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

  • For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

  • Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.


We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form, and we will work together to meet your needs.

We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.

Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!


Key Overview:
As a Member of Technical Staff in Post-Training, you will train our large language models (LLMs) with reinforcement learning and develop methods that help them generalize beyond the distribution they were trained on. You will design the training recipes, environments, and evaluations that tell us whether a model has truly learned a skill or has only fitted its training tasks, and turn what works into the recipes behind our production models. You will work closely with the post-training data infrastructure, evaluation, and pre-training teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, run, and analyse large-scale RL post-training experiments (e.g., RLHF, RL from verifiable rewards).

  • Research and develop methods that improve out-of-distribution generalization, such as reward design, environment and task diversity, curricula, and regularization.

  • Build held-out evaluations that measure generalization to unseen tasks, domains, and formats, and that catch reward hacking and benchmark overfitting.

  • Diagnose training dynamics and failure modes, including instability, reward over-optimization, and capability regressions.

  • Turn successful research into robust, reproducible training recipes for production models.


Qualifications

  • Strong research and software engineering skills, with hands-on experience training LLMs.

  • Experience applying reinforcement learning to LLMs (e.g., PPO, GRPO, RLHF, RLVR), ideally at scale.

  • Track record of work on generalization, robustness, or distribution shift, through publications or shipped models.

  • Rigorous experimental practice: clean ablations, careful controls, and sound conclusions from noisy results.

  • Experience with distributed training (e.g., JAX, PyTorch, FSDP, Megatron) is a plus.

  • Excellent communication skills.

  • Deep understanding of data quality principles and best practices: demonstrates willingness to dive deep into data while possessing strong intuition for assessing the quality of datasets and anticipating how different data characteristics will impact model training outcomes.

Working Location
This role can be based remotely or from one of our office locations listed on the job description - there is no minimum in-office qualification requirement. We care most about hiring exceptional people regardless of locations, though please check the location listed on the posting for guidance around the core time zone or working hours alignment expected for the role.

  • Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

  • RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

  • 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

  • Annual enrichment benefits:

    Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

    Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

  • 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

  • Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

How and Where We Work:

  • Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

  • For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

  • For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

  • Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Why this role?

Cohere has a strong AI narrative, the most deployable product, and a CEO who co-authored the foundational paper of modern AI. The company is positioned to become the transatlantic leader in sovereign AI for enterprise and government, and needs a storytelling engine to deliver that story at scale. This role sits within the team that is building that engine.

This is an opportunity to define the narratives that influence how enterprises, developers, and the broader ecosystem understand the future of AI and Cohere’s role in building it. In this cross‑functional, individual‑contributor role, you’ll partner deeply with product, research, engineering, and go‑to‑market teams to translate complex technical work into clear, compelling stories. You’ll help Cohere articulate what we’re building, why it matters, and how our technology is reshaping enterprise AI. You’ll craft narratives that resonate with technical and non‑technical audiences alike, and build programs that elevate Cohere’s product leadership and technical credibility.

This is a rare opportunity to build a product and technology communications function at a fast-growing company in the most dynamic space in technology. This is a role for someone who takes great joy at distilling technically complex ideas into mainstream messages that can be understood by all media globally.

As Product & Technology Communications Manager, you will:

  • Develop product and technology communications strategies that support Cohere’s business goals, product roadmap, and technical differentiation

  • Partner with product, engineering, research, and modeling leaders to craft messaging, narratives, and materials that explain Cohere’s technology in accessible, high-impact ways

  • Lead communications around product launches, including messaging frameworks, FAQs, press releases, and executive talking points

  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling content for customers, partners, analysts, and media

  • Collaborate with corporate comms to drive proactive storytelling that elevates Cohere’s technical leadership and product momentum

  • Work closely with marketing to ensure consistency across product marketing, developer content, and external communications

  • Support thought leadership for product, research, and modeling executives

  • Use qualitative and quantitative insights to refine messaging and understand what resonates with technical audiences

  • Prepare and support crisis and issues communications related to product, security, or technical incidents, partnering with Corporate Communications and relevant teams

You may be a good fit if you:

  • Have 5–7 years of experience in product and technology communications, or technical content — ideally in AI, enterprise software, or developer‑focused environments

  • Are an exceptional writer with a talent for simplifying complex technical topics without losing nuance

  • Have experience partnering with product and engineering leaders and can operate as a trusted advisor

  • Understand enterprise AI, machine learning, or developer ecosystems and are eager to go deeper

  • Are highly organized and detail‑oriented with strong project management skills and a bias for action

  • Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and thrive in fast‑moving, high‑growth environments

  • Have experience with product launches, technical content development, or developer‑focused communications

  • Build strong cross‑functional relationships to drive clarity, consistency, and alignment across teams

  • A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

  • Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

  • RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

  • 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

  • Annual enrichment benefits:

    Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

    Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

  • 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

  • Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

  • For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

  • For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

  • Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Why this role?

You'll own the full sales cycle—prospecting to close—for enterprise and Global 2000 organisations across the UK and Benelux in financial services, telecommunications, energy and utilities, manufacturing, healthcare and life sciences, and enterprise software. Sovereignty and control over where data and models reside are growing priorities across these sectors, and Cohere is well positioned to meet that need with private, on-premise and in-country deployment built for enterprise scale.

This is a territory with significant scope to build. You'll shape how we cover Benelux, work closely with our partner ecosystem to extend reach, and take Cohere deeper into UK and Northern European enterprise. Pipeline generation sits with you. This is a hunter role for someone who takes pride in building their own book rather than working leads handed to them.

This is a highly autonomous role demanding ownership of multi-million-dollar territories. You'll navigate intricate decision-making processes, educate C-suite stakeholders, and position Cohere as a strategic AI partner. Your insights will directly shape our product evolution, helping us prioritise features that drive enterprise adoption.

As a Sr. Account Executive, you will:

  • Drive net-new customer acquisition across the UK and Benelux via targeted outbound activity, executive introductions, and relationship building with key stakeholders

  • Support coverage of adjacent Northern European accounts as territory priorities require

  • Generate and own your own pipeline through disciplined outbound, research and executive prospecting

  • Be a trusted advisor to customer prospects, deeply understand their challenges & goals, and tailor solutions to drive impact for their businesses

  • Position Cohere's private, on-premise and in-country deployment options against the data residency, sovereignty and regulatory requirements of UK and European enterprise buyers, including the EU AI Act

  • Leverage senior-level relationships with executives to drive strategic partnerships and sales opportunities

  • Align closely with our partners and systems integrators to drive shared revenue and extend reach into target accounts

  • Work cross-functionally across the business, drawing in the right technical and specialist colleagues as each engagement requires

  • Collaborate with Cohere's Product and Engineering teams on strategic motions to deliver solutions to large enterprise customers

  • Collaborate with Sales Development Representatives and Marketing to supplement your own top of funnel activity

  • Own the full sales cycle – from initial outreach, technical and business validation, through deal close

You may be a good fit if you have:

  • Fluent English; Dutch is an advantage

  • 10+ years of B2B enterprise sales experience with Global 2000 and large enterprise customers along with experience negotiating & closing transformational 7-figure deals

  • Depth in at least two of our priority sectors: financial services, telecommunications, energy and utilities, manufacturing, healthcare and life sciences, enterprise software

  • A hunter mentality - you take pride in generating your own pipeline and are at your best when building a territory rather than managing an inherited one

  • A proven track record of high performance and exceeding quotas

  • Fluency with MEDDPICC - you qualify rigorously, can speak to metrics, economic buyer, decision criteria and process, champion and competition on any deal in your book, and keep that detail current in CRM so the forecast holds up to scrutiny

  • Experience building and maintaining senior-level relationships with executives

  • Experience selling complex enterprise level solutions, technical products, and private or on-premise deployments (AI/NLP solutions preferred)

  • Familiarity with UK and European data residency, sovereignty and regulatory requirements as live buying criteria

  • Experience working alongside channel partners and systems integrators to drive sales cycles and hit shared revenue goals

  • High tolerance for ambiguity - you'll need to be both a doer and a strategist, comfortable building your own approach rather than working to a pre-set one

  • Highly organized - this is a high activity role involving multiple team members and you are responsible for keeping everyone on track

  • Creativity - deal structures can widely vary, strong technical acumen and the ability to creatively structure mutually beneficial partnerships are necessary

  • Excellent communication skills - you are a great listener, have a knack for understanding what matters most to others & building strong relationships, experienced presenting to a C-suite audience, and feel comfortable speaking to both technical and non-technical customer prospects

  • Willingness to travel across the UK, Benelux and elsewhere in Northern Europe as required

  • Existing right to work in the UK

Full-Time Employees at Cohere enjoy these Perks:

  • A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

  • Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

  • RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

  • 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

  • Annual enrichment benefits:

    Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

    Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

  • 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

  • Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

How and Where We Work:

  • Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

  • For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

  • For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

  • Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.


We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form, and we will work together to meet your needs.

We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.

Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers page.

Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

About the Role

We're looking for a design engineer to help build and maintain Waypoint, our design system, across both the Figma library and the production codebase. This is not a "designer who codes a little" or an "engineer who dabbles in Figma" role. You should be genuinely fluent on both sides, comfortable defining a component's behavior and states in Figma one hour and shipping the same component to npm the next.

You'll take direct ownership of the Figma side of our library (structure, variants, tokens, documentation) while also contributing to the core Waypoint system: our component packages, our token pipeline, and the tooling that keeps design and code in sync. If the idea of being the single point of continuity between a Figma frame and a production component sounds exciting rather than exhausting, this is your role.

We're also thinking beyond the system we have today. Waypoint isn't just meant to serve designers and engineers, it's meant to become something a model can read, reason about, and build with directly. We want someone who can help us get there: grounded enough to do the unglamorous work of making today's system solid, and forward looking enough to help define what an intelligent design system looks like next.



Why this role

Waypoint is still early enough that the decisions you make now will shape how the system scales. You'll have real ownership, not just a queue of component tickets, and you'll be working alongside a team that treats design and engineering as one discipline rather than two departments that hand work back and forth. And you'll be helping define what a design system becomes when it has to serve a third audience: the models that will increasingly build with it.

Responsibilities

  • Own and evolve the Figma library for Waypoint: component structure, variants, properties, and documentation, so it stays a reliable source of truth for design teams.

  • Build and maintain core Waypoint components, contributing directly to our component packages alongside the design engineering team.

  • Work across our token pipeline, keeping design tokens in Figma and their code representations (CSS custom properties, Tailwind config) tightly synced.

  • Partner with product designers to translate new patterns into system components, and with product engineers to make sure those components are easy to adopt correctly.

  • Help define and refine the workflows and tooling that connect Figma and code (sync scripts, plugins, documentation sites) rather than relying on manual handoff.

  • Write clear documentation and usage guidance so the system scales without you being the bottleneck.

  • Weigh in on system architecture decisions: when to add a new component versus extend an existing one, how to version and package changes, how to keep the system consistent as it grows.

  • Help shape how Waypoint evolves to serve a third consumer beyond designers and engineers: the model itself. That means thinking about how components, tokens, and patterns get structured so they're legible to AI systems, not just to humans.

Qualifications

  • Own and evolve the Figma library for Waypoint: component structure, variants, properties, and documentation, so it stays a reliable source of truth for design teams.

  • Build and maintain core Waypoint components, contributing directly to our component packages alongside the design engineering team.

  • Work across our token pipeline, keeping design tokens in Figma and their code representations (CSS custom properties, Tailwind config) tightly synced.

  • Partner with product designers to translate new patterns into system components, and with product engineers to make sure those components are easy to adopt correctly.

  • Help define and refine the workflows and tooling that connect Figma and code (sync scripts, plugins, documentation sites) rather than relying on manual handoff.

  • Write clear documentation and usage guidance so the system scales without you being the bottleneck.

  • Weigh in on system architecture decisions: when to add a new component versus extend an existing one, how to version and package changes, how to keep the system consistent as it grows.

  • Help shape how Waypoint evolves to serve a third consumer beyond designers and engineers: the model itself. That means thinking about how components, tokens, and patterns get structured so they're legible to AI systems, not just to humans.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience building or contributing to design-to-code sync tooling (Figma plugins, token pipelines, MCP-based workflows, or similar).

  • Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG) and how to bake them into components rather than bolt them on.

  • Experience packaging and versioning component libraries for multiple consuming teams (npm scoped packages, semver, changelogs).

  • Exposure to multi-platform design systems work (iOS/SwiftUI, Android/Jetpack Compose, or token build tools like Style Dictionary).

  • Experience in an AI native product environment or genuine interest in how AI changes the way design systems get built and used.

Full-Time Employees at Cohere enjoy these Perks:

  • A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

  • Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

  • RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

  • 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

  • Annual enrichment benefits:

    Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

    Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

  • 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

  • Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

How and Where We Work:

  • Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

  • For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

  • For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

  • Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.

Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Role Overview
As a Member of Technical Staff in Post-Training Data Infrastructure, you will build and own the pipelines that produce the post-training data for our large language models (LLMs), from SFT and RL data to synthetic and human-annotated data. You will work closely with researchers and annotation teams so they can iterate on data as quickly as they iterate on models.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain data pipelines for SFT, preference, and RL post-training data.

  • Own dataset quality, versioning, and reproducibility.

  • Turn research data recipes into production-grade, reusable components.

  • Scale model inference for data generation and model-based grading.

  • Design data formats and schemas that keep post-training datasets consistent and efficient to train on.

  • Collaborate with researchers and engineers to make sure data pipelines keep pace with the needs of cutting-edge language models.

Qualifications

  • Strong software engineering skills.

  • Experience designing and building large-scale data pipelines for machine learning, ideally for LLM post-training.

  • Track record of running distributed data processing and model inference at scale.

  • Good understanding of post-training methods (e.g., SFT, RLHF, DPO) and how data shapes model behaviour.

  • Excellent communication skills.

This is neither an exhaustive nor necessary set of attributes. Even if none of these apply to you, but you believe you will contribute to Cohere, please reach out. We value diverse backgrounds and perspectives at Cohere

 


Full-Time Employees at Cohere enjoy these Perks:

  • A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

  • Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

  • RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

  • 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

  • Annual enrichment benefits:

    Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

    Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

  • 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

  • Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

How and Where We Work:

  • Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

  • For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

  • For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

  • Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.

Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

About the role

We're hiring a Chief of Staff to keep Cohere's AI organization running at full speed. You'll report to and support the Chief AI Officer and work to bridge across all teams and functions at Cohere (including research, modelling, product, delivery, security, sales and operations). In any given quarter, the org ships new AI product demos and releases, customer pilots and scaled solutions, security updates, often across regions and time zones. Your job is to make sure the right work priorities win when everything feels urgent, that our plans turn into high-quality shipped work, and that our Chief AI Officer can focus on leading instead of firefighting.

Much of this is operational: the planning calendar, the budget, the headcount plan, the weekly business reviews, the communication strategy (internal and external), the cross-functional handoffs. Your role is the operating rhythm of the org: meetings, priorities, plans, and the decisions that come out of them. You will be a member of an experienced, high-performing and supportive leadership team.


What you'll own

Own the operating rhythm and planning: annual and quarterly planning, goal-setting, and the weekly and monthly business reviews. Drive budget and headcount planning against the slate, and keep both honest as priorities shift mid-quarter.

Keep major programs from colliding or stalling across research, modelling, product, delivery, and security. Be the person teams come to when it isn't clear who owns a decision, or how to navigate trade-offs.

Be the connective tissue between the Chief AI Officer’s org and the rest of the company: cross-functional planning with product, engineering, security, and finance, so the org's commitments are realistic and its dependencies are visible.

Own and lead special projects: Lead the things that don't fit neatly on any one team's plate: a reorg, a new partnership, a flagship research event, an org-wide planning week. Own them end to end.


Who you are

You have 12+ years of operating experience, with real time inside an AI/ML organization in a Chief of Staff, business operations, or senior program-operations seat. You know how to partner with teams shipping fast & often to high-stakes organizations, and you know how to change course with agility when needed.

You understand how AI actually works—at the level of someone who's done it rather than managed it from a distance. You can talk credibly about how a model turns into a product, what data requirements demand from both research and engineering, and where delivery motions usually break. You're fluent in the numbers. Model performance metrics, data pipeline throughput, budget-to-impact. You don't have to run every program yourself. You do have to understand them well enough that the people who run them respect your judgment.

You hold strategy and execution in the same hand. You can sit in a planning conversation with the Chief AI Officer in the morning and chase down a stuck deliverable in the afternoon.

You thrive in a fast-paced environment, you handle ambiguity with curiosity and confidence, you stay calm when it's messy. You have a track record of bringing order to a fast, complex org without grinding it to a halt.

You are an outstanding communicator and know how to wield soft power. Clear writing, straight talk, the ability to influence teams and individuals, and the executive presence to represent the Chief AI Officer in high-stakes conversations.

Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Why this role?

This role is for a highly experienced Back-End Software Engineer who wants to work on core systems that shape how the platform (Model Vault) operates. You will help define the architecture of the platform where reliability, security, performance, and simplicity all matter, and where many of the problems do not have off-the-shelf solutions.

Model Vault is Cohere’s inference platform for deploying and operating models securely at enterprise scale. The team owns the systems between a customer and the underlying AI infrastructure, including identity, deployments, metering, billing, security, privacy, and confidential computing. We are strengthening these systems as Model Vault grows, with the goal of scaling to millions of users and supporting some of the world’s most demanding enterprise workloads.

As a Senior/Staff Software Engineer, you will:

  • Evolve and scale the backend systems that power Model Vault, including authentication and authorization, deployment management, billing, metering, and customer lifecycle.

  • Lead major architectural initiatives across identity, payments, usage systems, platform scalability, and other core product foundations.

  • Build highly reliable control-plane services for provisioning, configuring, scaling, and operating model deployments across clouds and hardware platforms.

  • Design APIs and distributed systems with strong guarantees around correctness, consistency, isolation, failure recovery, idempotency, and observability.

  • Build security and privacy into the platform architecture, including tenant isolation, least-privilege access, auditability, secrets management, encryption, and confidential computing boundaries.

  • Solve complex problems that span backend systems, cloud infrastructure, security, and AI inference, where conventional SaaS patterns are often not enough.

  • Drive projects end-to-end, from architecture and threat modeling through implementation, rollout, production operations, and iteration based on real customer workloads.

You may be a good fit if:

  • You are a strong backend engineer with excellent fundamentals in distributed systems, databases, networking, operating systems, and security.

  • You have strong programming fundamentals and experience building production systems in languages such as Go, Python, Java, C++, Rust, or similar. You write clean, maintainable, well-tested code and make thoughtful tradeoffs between simplicity, performance, and correctness.

  • You have designed and operated production systems where correctness, availability, security, and performance mattered at significant scale.

  • You can take ambiguous, high-impact technical problems, define the right architecture, and drive them through to reliable production systems.

  • You have strong systems-design instincts and understand concepts such as concurrency, consistency, caching, queues, rate limiting, backpressure, failure domains, idempotency, and graceful degradation.

  • You think deeply about security boundaries and understand authentication, authorization, identity, cryptography, secrets, tenant isolation, and how small implementation choices can create significant security risks.

  • You are comfortable reasoning across backend services, APIs, databases, distributed systems, and the cloud infrastructure they run on.

  • You are comfortable diving into unfamiliar codebases and debugging complex problems that cross service or system boundaries.

  • You care about the details of production engineering, including instrumentation, capacity planning, migrations, backwards compatibility, incident response, and safe rollouts.

  • You are comfortable challenging existing architecture and evolving foundational components when the system’s needs change.

  • You have a track record of taking technically difficult projects from an unclear starting point to systems that other engineers and customers depend on.
